package shop

import "testing"

func TestHiddenBug(t *testing.T) {
	items := []Item{{SKU: "a"}, {SKU: "b"}, {SKU: "c"}, {SKU: "d"}, {SKU: "e"}}
	cases := []struct {
		page, size int
		want       string
	}{
		{1, 2, "ab"}, {2, 2, "cd"}, {3, 2, "e"}, {4, 2, ""}, {1, 5, "abcde"}, {1, 9, "abcde"}, {2, 5, ""}, {0, 2, ""}, {1, 0, ""},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		got := ""
		for _, item := range Page(items, c.page, c.size) {
			got += item.SKU
		}
		if got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("Page(5 items, %d, %d) = %q, want %q", c.page, c.size, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}
